# AI behaviour & simulation

[Home](README.md) · [Getting started](getting-started.md) · [Magic](magic.md) · [Abyss Fruits](fruits.md) · [Companions](companions.md) · [AI & simulation](ai-and-simulation.md) · [World events](world-events.md) · [Mobs & bosses](mobs-and-bosses.md) · [Items & recipes](items-and-recipes.md) · [Progression](progression.md) · [Commands](commands.md) · [FAQ](faq.md) · [Development](development.md)

---

This is the heart of the early-access releases: NPCs that fight with intent, battles that play out like small wars, and a world that keeps moving when you are not looking. Everything here is in `src/scripts/living/`.

## The tactical brain (`ai.js`)

Magic Knights and Raider Captains are run by one shared brain. It "thinks" every 5-8 ticks (staggered so big battles stay smooth).

### Fighting style

Worked out from the spells the NPC knows:

| Style | Comes from | Behaviour |
|---|---|---|
| **Striker** | bolts, beams, sky strikes, radial bursts, meteors | casts from range; backs away from foes closer than ~4.5 blocks |
| **Controller** | prisons, zones, vortices, rain, earth waves, time stop | waits for enemies to bunch up, then locks them down |
| **Brawler** | novas around itself, dashes, dives (and every beast-fruit captain) | charges in, uses close-range blasts and gap-closers |
| **Support** | heals, rewinds, buffs that reach allies | stays back, heals and buffs hurt friends |

### Traits

* **Skill** (0.40-0.95, +0.02 per knight level): aim, how often it dodges, how quickly it casts again (26 + 40·(1-skill) ticks between casts), how much randomness creeps into its choices.
* **Courage** (0.15-1.00): below 30% health an NPC with courage under 0.6 falls back toward its friends for 3 s; in battles courage also decides who flees when morale breaks.

### Choosing a spell

Every known spell that is off cooldown gets a score for this moment; the best one above a threshold is cast (low-skill NPCs add some noise):

| Spell kind | Scores high when |
|---|---|
| bolt | the target is 2.5-24 blocks away (more if it bursts or pierces and enemies are bunched) |
| beam / wave | the target is in reach; more for every enemy near it |
| zone / rain / meteor / vortex / prison | enemies are clustered around the target (+3 per enemy) |
| nova (self / front) | enemies are within the blast radius (+4 each) |
| sky strikes | several enemies are near the aim point |
| time stop | three or more enemies are within range |
| heal / rewind | an ally within 10 blocks has lost over 35% health, or the caster is under half health |
| buff | it is not already buffed (re-buffs after 12 s) |
| summon | it has fewer than two constructs out |
| blink | a caster is cornered and hurt (blinks *away*), or a brawler is far from its target (blinks *in*) |
| dash / dive | the target is in leaping range; more with enemies around it |

Each spell then goes on its own cooldown (the grimoire cooldown × 1.5 for knights). Classic fruit powers without a recipe are simply used when the target is within 14 blocks.

### Aiming, dodging and targets

* **Leading:** bolts are aimed where a moving target *will be*, scaled by skill, with a little wobble for low skill.
* **Dodging:** each think, spells and arrows within 8 blocks that will pass within 1.8 blocks and arrive within 14 ticks are side-stepped, with a chance of 75% × skill (cooldown 30-60 ticks).
* **Targets:** foes within 24 blocks are scored - closer, weaker, the army's focus target (+10), whoever just hurt it (+6), enemy leaders (+3), and its current target (+5, so it does not thrash).
* **Who counts as a foe:** the other armies in a battle; otherwise its side's enemies (see [Mobs](mobs-and-bosses.md#who-fights-whom)) and players - peaceful NPCs only fight a player who struck them (they hold a grudge for 30 s).

## Enemy brains

The same brain also drives the spellcasting enemies. They aim, dodge, retreat and pick targets the same way, with lower skill (0.30-0.80) and a slower casting rhythm:

| Enemy | Spells |
|---|---|
| Dark Disciple | locks every foe within 2.5 blocks of your aim in place for 2s, then 4 damage / 3 blade bolts in a 14° fan; 5 damage each; weakness (3s) |
| Imp | 1 orb bolt; 4 damage; sets on fire (2s) / leap high and crash onto your aim (2.5-block impact, you are protected during the dive); 6 damage |
| Sea Raider | 1 orb bolt; 6 damage; bursts in a 2.5-block radius; lobbed (falls) |
| Raider Gunner | 1 needle bolt; 6 damage / 1 orb bolt; 7 damage; bursts in a 2.8-block radius; lobbed (falls) |
| Tidewatch Marksman | 1 needle bolt; 7 damage / 3 needle bolts in a 6° fan; 4 damage each |
| Hellhound | dash up to 8 blocks, hitting everything on the way; 7 damage; sets on fire (3s) / instant beam, 6 blocks long, 1.4 wide; 5 damage; sets on fire (4s) |
| Mana Wraith | instant beam, 14 blocks long, 1 wide; 5 damage; heals you for 50% of the damage / blink up to 8 blocks, hitting everything on the way; 3 damage / locks every foe within 3 blocks of your aim in place for 2s, then 3 damage |

* **Gunners and Marksmen** raise their guns (an aiming animation) before every shot and back away from anyone within 5 blocks.
* **Hellhounds hunt in packs:** while their lunge recharges, every hound near the same prey circles it at 4-6 blocks, then they lunge in turn.
* **Calling for help:** hurt a Dark Disciple, Imp, Sea Raider, Gunner, Sentinel, Marksman, Hellhound or Mana Wraith and every one of its kind nearby joins the fight.
* **Animations:** knights play a different cast animation for each kind of spell (raise for sky spells and heals, channel for beams and fields, slam for blasts), dodge with a side-lean, flinch when hit, salute, cheer and sit; enemies shoot, throw, bite and cast.

## Boss brains (`bosses.js`)

|  |  |
|---|---|
| **Threat** | every boss remembers how much damage each attacker dealt (knights and companions fighting in melee count 60% extra, so they can tank) and turns on the biggest threat, only switching when someone out-does its current target by 10%. You are told when it turns on you. |
| **Phases** | below 50% health it enrages (roar, Strength, Resistance, new attacks, 25% faster); below 25% it uses its **desperation** move once and attacks faster again |
| **Telegraphs** | slams, stomps and waves show a warning circle about a second before they land |
| **Movement** | the Archdevil blinks away when two or more foes crowd it; the Colossus stomps them back; the Kraken submerges and resurfaces by its prey; the Galleon keeps station above you; the Fallen Captain blinks behind you and side-steps spells; the Witch Sisters and the Soul Puppeteer blink away from melee; the Bone Dragon circles overhead and dives |
| **Enrage timer** | after six minutes of fighting any boss becomes furious: Strength III, Speed II, 40% stronger spells and 30% faster attacks |

See [Mobs & bosses](mobs-and-bosses.md#bosses) for every boss's attacks.

## Battles (`battle.js`)

Battles come from the **War Table**, the **Skirmish Horn**, and world events (skirmishes, tournaments, offensives).

### Armies

| Army | Soldiers | Leader |
|---|---|---|
| **Clover Magic Knights** | Magic Knight | – |
| **Devil Host** | Dark Disciple, Hellhound, Imp | – |
| **Sea Raiders** | Raider Gunner, Sea Raider | Raider Captain |
| **Tidewatch Navy** | Tidewatch Marksman, Tidewatch Sentinel | Tidewatch Commodore |
| **Ancient Constructs** | Ancient Construct | – |
| **Rogue Mages** | Rogue Mage | – |

### Set-up

* Two armies face each other 20 blocks apart; with a third (Gold) army they stand in a triangle.
* **Formation:** melee soldiers in the front rank, spellcasters (knights, disciples) and the leader behind, six to a row.
* A 3-2-1 countdown freezes everyone; then the horn sounds and the fight begins.

### Tactics

| Tactic | What the army does |
|---|---|
| **Charge** | everyone gets Speed II for 5 s and rushes in |
| **Hold the line** | soldiers stay on their spawn spots for up to 25 s unless the enemy comes within 11 blocks |
| **Flank** | every other soldier first swings around the side (a point 60° off the centre line) for up to 11 s, then attacks |
| **Skirmish** | mages keep their distance and fight at range (other soldiers fight normally) |

### Morale

* Every army starts at **100** morale.
* Each fallen soldier costs 75 ÷ (army size); a fallen **leader** costs 30. Every enemy death gives the other armies +3.
* Being outnumbered by the strongest enemy army 1.5:1 costs 2 per second, 2:1 costs 4 per second.
* Morale recovers 1.5 per second while the leader lives, 0.4 per second without.
* Below **30** soldiers may **flee** (more likely when morale is lower and courage is low): they run from the enemy and are gone once 34 blocks away. Above **55** they **rally** back to the fight.
* An army with **no one left fighting** (everyone dead, gone or running) loses. After 4 minutes the battle is a draw. Duels have no morale.

### Leaders and focus

* A living leader gives soldiers within 10 blocks Strength I.
* Every second each army picks a **focus target** - the weakest enemy near its centre - that its soldiers prefer.

### Watching

* A **scoreboard** sidebar shows each army's soldiers and morale; the action bar shows the count to anyone within 64 blocks.
* A **kill feed** in chat names who defeated whom, who fled and who rallied.
* A **battle report** at the end lists losses, fled and running soldiers, the winning side and the **most valuable** fighter (25 points per kill + 1 per damage).
* The **cinematic camera** circles the battle 20 blocks out and 11 up, always looking at the middle of the armies. Sneak to leave it.
* **Bets:** stake doubloons on a side at the War Table. A win pays 2× (3× with three armies); a draw returns the stake.
* After the battle the survivors march off (they vanish after 10 s).

## The world simulation (`worldsim.js`)

The four great factions - **Clover Magic Knights**, **Devil Host**, **Sea Raiders**, **Tidewatch Navy** - each have a **power** from 5 to 95 (start 50), saved with the world.

| What happens | Effect on power |
|---|---|
| one of its people dies in the wild | −0.3 (−0.5 if a player killed it); a killer from another faction +0.3 |
| it wins a real battle (event skirmish or offensive - not War Table games) | winner +6, losers −6, and it makes the news |
| a Devil Gate is sealed | Devil Host −5 |
| the Archdevil dies | Devil Host −15 |
| the Phantom Galleon is sunk | Sea Raiders −10 |
| every 5 minutes | drifts 4% back toward 50, plus a random ±1.5 |
| every 5 minutes, 35% chance | two rivals clash off screen: the stronger usually wins (+3 / −3) and the news reaches you |

* **Event odds follow power:** an event tied to a faction is weighted by 0.4 + 1.2 × power/100 (×1.0 at 50, ×1.48 at 90). Devil Gates and Crimson Nights follow the Devil Host, pirate landings the Sea Raiders, knight patrols the Knights; skirmishes pick stronger factions more often (60% against their rival).
* **Offensives:** when a faction reaches **80**, it launches an offensive near a random player: a 7-9 a side battle against its rival (Knights ↔ Devils, Raiders ↔ Navy), attackers charging or flanking, defenders holding the line. At most one every 20 minutes, and only while world events are on.
* **News:** the last ten notable things (battles, sealed gates, boss deaths, off-screen wars) with the in-game day.
* **State of the Kingdom:** open it from the Handbook or a War Table to see the power bars and the news.

## Knights: levels and orders

Magic Knights spawn by day in plains, forests, meadows and savannas (groups of 1-3), in world events and in battles. Each has a generated name, one of 23 attributes (shown by the glyph over its head), one of the nine squad robes, a skill and a courage.

| Level | Knight XP | Rank | Spells known |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 | Junior | 2 |
| 2 | 20 | Junior | 2 |
| 3 | 60 | Intermediate | 3 |
| 4 | 120 | Intermediate | 3 |
| 5 | 200 | Senior | 3 |
| 6 | 320 | Senior | 4 (ultimate) |
| 7 | 480 | First Class | 4 (ultimate) |
| 8 | 700 | First Class | 4 (ultimate) |
| 9 | 1000 | Vice-Captain | 4 (ultimate) |
| 10 | 1400 | Captain | 4 (ultimate) |

* Knights earn 10 XP per kill (18 for this addon's creatures, 150 for a boss) and cast 5% harder per level.
* Knights whose attribute predates the spell engine use a two-spell kit:

| Attribute | Kit |
|---|---|
| Wind | 3 blade bolts in a 12° fan; 4 damage each; knockback / 5-block blast around you; 5 damage; knockback |
| Flame | 1 orb bolt; 6 damage; bursts in a 2-block radius; sets on fire (4s) / 4 strikes over 3 blocks around your aim, one every 0.20s; 7 damage each; sets on fire (4s) |
| Water | 2 orb bolts in a 6° fan; 4 damage each / heals you and allies within 6 blocks for 6 HP, removes poison/wither/slowness/weakness/blindness/nausea |
| Lightning | 1 needle bolt; 6 damage / strikes up to 3 foes within 8 blocks of your aim from the sky; 7 damage each |
| Light | 3 blade bolts in a 10° fan; 4 damage each / instant beam, 22 blocks long, 1 wide; 9 damage |
| Dark | 1 blade bolt; 7 damage; pierces 2 foes / pulls foes within 5 blocks of your aim together for 1.5s, then bursts; 6 damage |
| Ice | 1 needle bolt; 5 damage; slowness 2 (3s) / locks every foe within 3 blocks of your aim in place for 3s, then 4 damage |
| Spatial | 1 orb bolt; 5 damage / blink up to 8 blocks, hitting everything on the way; 4 damage |
| Earth | 3 orb bolts in a 8° fan; 4 damage each; lobbed (falls) / eruptions along the ground forward, 10 blocks; 8 damage; knockback |
| Steel | 3 blade bolts in a 6° fan; 5 damage each / 6 strikes over 3 blocks around your aim, one every 0.10s; 5 damage each |
| Mirror | instant beam, 20 blocks long, 1 wide; 7 damage / 2 shard bolts in a 8° fan; 4 damage each |

### Recruiting and orders

* **Talk** to a knight (interact) to see its profile: magic, rank, level and XP, fighting style, skill, courage and kills.
* **Recruit** a wild knight with a Knight Contract or 100 + 25 × level doubloons, or use a Knight Contract anywhere to call a new level-2 knight. You can lead up to **4**.
* Talk to your own knights to order them:

| Order | Effect |
|---|---|
| Follow me | follows you (teleports to you if more than 24 blocks away) |
| Hold this position | guards the spot where it stands, returning to it when no foe is within 12 blocks |
| Stance: aggressive | hunts any foe nearby (default) |
| Stance: defensive | only fights foes within 10 blocks of you |
| Release from service | the knight goes its own way |

Knights you recruit become **companions** - see [Companions](companions.md).
